free_tier.stated: None stated: the pricing page says 'Get started today and only pay for what you use, at per-second granularity. No up-front costs.' Runtime, including sandboxes, is billed by requested resources at $0.0249 per vCPU-hour and $0.0080 per GiB-hour preemptible, with GPUs from $0.54 an hour for a T4 and $4.29 an hour for an H100.
free_tier.notes: There is no free monthly allowance or trial allowance on the read pages; the billing docs say Context nodes are billed by uptime and Runtime and Learning by per-second resource requests. The sign-up page shows no card field, and the card gate inside the dashboard is unverified: behind a sign-up.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not an object. Volumes are $0.09 per GiB-month and a sandbox mounts versioned volumes for repos, datasets or model weights.

retention.stated: A Sandbox is an isolated environment for a single ephemeral task, torn down when the task finishes; no post-run file retention period is published on the read pages and is unverified: behind a sign-up.

egress.terms: Network egress is $0.04 per GiB and ingress has no charge. Sandboxes inside a customer cloud account default-deny egress with hostname, CIDR and port allowlists; a hosted lane routes tool calls through the Chalk MCP gateway.

interface_detail: A Sandbox is defined and invoked in Python through the chalkcompute SDK; the docs also describe a REST API and a chalk CLI usage command, and a hosted serverless lane reached by signup.
tooling: the chalkcompute Python SDK, the chalk CLI and the dashboard; no SSH endpoint or rclone backend is published for the sandbox.
chaining: A sandbox can be given a knowledge cutoff so the MCP gateway replays tools and context against a consistent historical snapshot, and versioned volumes let parallel sandboxes mount the same repo, dataset or model.

limits.value: runtime is metered by the second as (vCPU x CPU rate + GiB x memory rate + GPUs x GPU rate) x runtime, with no free runtime allowance stated
non-preemptible workloads run for up to 24 hours; custom non-preemptible durations require Enterprise
network egress is $0.04 per GiB, with default-deny egress controlled by hostname, CIDR and port allowlists

limits_note: Not every GPU type is available in every environment; quotas are listed in the Chalk dashboard. Committed-use contracts unlock volume discounts and self-hosted deployment options on Enterprise.
binding_note: No free runtime allowance is published and the meter starts at the per-second resource rate, so usage cost binds before the 24-hour non-preemptible duration or the egress price.

identity_cost.detail: The self-service signup page is titled 'Get started with Chalk'; its browser-rendered form shows 'Email' beside an 'or' selector and a 'Log in' link, with no phone, document or card field in the rendered page. The plain HTML fetch renders only a loading spinner, which is why the field was missed earlier. The hosted serverless lane says 'Sign up and your environment is ready.' The card gate inside the dashboard is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Preemptible rates apply unless non-preemptible workloads are explicitly requested, and they run at most 24 hours; Context node cost is independent of load and the branch server shuts down after a default idle period of 1 hour. Sandboxes are torn down when a task finishes, so unsaved work is lost.
confidence_note: Rates, egress price, the per-second billing formula, the ephemeral sandbox definition and the two deployment lanes are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-25. The signup Email field was read from a browser-rendered capture of the same URL; the in-dashboard card gate is unverified: behind a sign-up.
